intent.productGoal: Show whether service-line revenue movement arises from mix, same-store continuation, or an explicitly evidenced new/discontinued service without inventing a professional conclusion.
intent.capability: Ingest Service_Line_History separately, present run-bound new/discontinued-service evidence, and compare current versus prior service-line billed populations only when the source supports that period basis.
architecturalIntent: Supplemental scenario evidence remains separately typed and traceable.
Derived comparison and professional interpretation remain separate.
invariants: History labels derive only from supplied rows.
Comparison never alters financial controls or release gates.

observedBehaviour: Browser run ingested both source-traceable history events: Urology new_service_expansion effective 2026-01-01 and Dermatology service_discontinuation effective 2026-04-01.
All four reconciliations matched; G1, G3 and G4 passed, while G2, G5, G6 and G7 remained not passed.
The January-through-valuation-date prior-year comparison population was zero for every service line, so this run cannot substantiate mix versus rate/volume or same-store movement.

evidence.result: Records history source rows, comparison values, source inventory, matching reconciliations, and gates.
Shows matched controls, G4 analysis, and draft-only export gate state.

divergences.expected: A populated prior-period comparison supports service-line movement decomposition.
divergences.observed: All prior YTD service-line populations are zero under the implemented window.
